editorial:
Imagine you are eighteen years old and every single day feels like a countdown. That is the feeling you get here as you follow a group of high school grads during their very last summer at home. You will meet a mix of characters, from the popular kids to the outcasts, all trying to figure out who they are before they head off to college. The vibe is very sunny and nostalgic, capturing that weird mix of excitement and fear that comes with growing up. It feels like a warm breeze and a late-night party where everyone is just trying to make memories that will last a lifetime.

You will likely enjoy the chemistry between the young actors, as they make the awkward flirting and friendship fights feel real. While the plot is pretty simple and doesn't have many big shocks, it is a perfect easy-watch for a rainy afternoon. If you love coming-of-age stories, you should definitely check this one out. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep those summer vibes forever.
endingExplained: As the summer ends, the friends finally face the truth about their feelings. Some couples realize they are better off as friends, while others decide to try long-distance relationships. The movie wraps up with the group saying their final goodbyes before leaving for different colleges. It ends on a hopeful note, showing that while their childhood is over, they have grown enough to handle the big changes coming their way in adulthood.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sweet teen romances and stories about growing up.
